16                SENATOR KENNEDY:   Thank you, 

17   Mr. President.

18                I'm proud to rise in support of this 

19   important legislation to commemorate the life and 

20   sacrifices of the late New York State Trooper 

21   Kevin Patrick Dobson, Sr.  He is remembered as a 

22   loving father and dedicated officer whose 

23   commitment to public safety always remained 

24   unwavering.  

25                Trooper Dobson gave his life in 


                                                                3570

 1   service to the State of New York.  He was struck 

 2   and killed by a vehicle on the I-290, near the 

 3   Colvin Boulevard exit, during a traffic stop in 

 4   March of 2011.  

 5                His life was taken in the line of 

 6   duty while he was working to keep our roads 

 7   safe.  Now it's up to us to ensure the memory of 

 8   Trooper Dobson, and the sacrifices he made, live 

 9   on for generations to come.

10                This legislation will designate the 

11   Interstate 290 bridge that crosses State Route 

12   425 as the New York State Trooper Kevin P. Dobson 

13   Sr. Memorial Bridge.  It will serve as a reminder 

14   for all Western New Yorkers that our highways 

15   were made safe by Trooper Dobson and his brothers 

16   and sisters in uniform.

17                It will memorialize the life of 

18   Trooper Dobson and help demonstrate our steadfast 

19   gratitude for the selfless actions of the 

20   hardworking men and women who serve in the 

21   State Police force and local police agencies.

22                In the days and months since his 

23   life was tragically taken in the line of duty, 

24   our community has sought ways to commemorate 

25   Trooper Dobson's service and sacrifice.  The 


                                                                3571

 1   Trooper Kevin Dobson Memorial Bridge will 

 2   complement the State Police efforts to 

 3   commemorate his life with a new monument at the 

 4   Clarence Barracks, where he nobly served.  

 5                Trooper Kevin Dobson was forever 

 6   committed to his duty to protect and serve our 

 7   community.  He went above and beyond, always 

 8   working hard to keep our roads and neighborhoods 

 9   safe.

10                Today our thoughts and prayers go 

11   out to Trooper Dobson's family and friends, and 

12   we thank all those who have dedicated their lives 

13   to law enforcement.  Trooper Dobson made the 

14   ultimate sacrifice, and the memory of that 

15   sacrifice and his over 13 years of service to 

16   this state will live on for years to come, as 

17   motorists every day cross the soon-to-be-named 

18   Trooper Kevin P. Dobson Sr. Memorial Bridge.  

19                I had the opportunity to speak to 

20   Dick Dobson, the father of Trooper Dobson, a few 

21   weeks back when we introduced this legislation, 

22   and again today when I saw it was coming to the 

23   floor for this vote.  The level of gratitude and 

24   appreciation felt by his family for this gesture 

25   is immeasurable, and I was asked to pass on this 


                                                                3572

 1   sentiment to this honorable body.

 2                Trooper Dobson left behind children 

 3   Kevin Patrick Jr., Jamie Kathleen, and Brooke 

 4   Lauren Dobson, as well as stepson Andrew Hastings

10   Transportation Committee, Senator Fuschillo, for

14   Senate, and I'm hopeful the Assembly will move 

15   quickly to pass this legislation and to move it 

16   to the Governor's desk for his signature.
